story_text:
## The InfiMech MX Series Arrives
VIP Cashback Rules: Please pay the standard pledge amount upfront at checkout. The $50 VIP discount will be refunded to your original payment account after your printer is shipped.
Multiple VIPs & Printers: Each VIP reservation unlocks a $50 refund for one printer. For example, if you reserve 2 VIP spots and pledge for 2 printers, you will receive a total refund of $100 after shipment.
## 8-Tools,Endless Possibilities
True 8-tool switching architecture for seamless multi-color and multi-material printing. Eliminates filament waste towers and significantly accelerates execution times.
Engineered for seamless multi-material and multi-color execution, the InfiMech MX Series features an array of independent tool docks with individual filament pathways.
- Dedicated Channel Design: Each tool maintains an independent filament path, preventing cross-contamination and eliminating multi-color bleed.
- Precision Mechanical Alignment: High-precision guide rails and docking mechanisms ensure reliable tool pickup and release with sub-millimeter repeatable accuracy.
- Streamlined Filament Management: Integrated PTFE routing and sensors ensure smooth filament feeding and instant strain detection.
## Near-Zero Waste Multi-Color Printing
Unlike traditional single-nozzle systems that purge material during every single color swap, the InfiMech MX Series utilizes a smart independent tool architecture.
- One Priming Per Tool: Each tool purges only once upon its first activation to ensure the melt zone is perfectly filled.
- No Repeated Purging: Subsequent color switches require no further filament waste throughout the entire print.
- Maximum Waste Reduction: Printing an 8-color model produces only 8 small purge drops in total—reducing material waste and printing time to the absolute minimum.
## Induction Heating
Cutting-edge electromagnetic induction technology rockets nozzle temperatures from ambient to operating heat in just 8 seconds, eliminating prep waiting times and optimizing multi-tool efficiency.
## Contactless NFC Temperature Sensing
Reads precise thermal data using high-accuracy thermistors and transmits signal via NFC. No physical pins to wear out, no wiring clutter, and zero connection errors during tool swaps.
## Active Anti-Blob Detection
Dedicated printhead sensor actively detects hotend filament buildup in real time. Automatically pauses printing and triggers an on-screen alert to prevent hotend destruction and component damage.
## Filament Tangle Detection
Tool-integrated Hall sensor monitors filament feed tension in real time. Automatically pauses printing and prompts on-screen alerts when a spool tangle is detected, protecting your extruder and saving long prints.
Automatically pauses printing when the filament spool rns out, saving your job and allowing instant spool replacements.
## Smart Closed-Loop Cooling
## Side-Mounted Auxiliary Cooling Fan
Auxiliary Part Cooling: A dedicated interior side fan delivers targeted high-volume airflow across the build platform. Enhances overhangs, bridging, and surface finish at extreme speeds without adding weight to the tool.
Saves printing status and coordinates in non-volatile memory during unexpected blackouts. Prompts a one-touch resume upon power restoration to save time, energy, and filament.
## Spaghetti Detection & Foreign Object Detection
AI-assisted camera monitoring that automatically pauses execution when prints fail.
Visual bed inspection that detects left-over tools or debris before homing to prevent nozzle crashes.
Precision Tool Calibration: Multi-point perimeter probing → Instant exact center calculation for absolute alignment on every tool swap.
## HEPA + Activated Carbon Air Purifier
## Active Heated Chamber
Actively warms the build enclosure up to 60–65°C. Prevents shrinkage, layer delamination, and warping when printing engineering materials like ABS, ASA, PC, and Nylon.
Filters out fine particulates and absorbs harmful fumes and odors. Designed for safer indoor printing with high-temp materials like ABS and ASA.
## Active Collision Recovery
## XY Closed-Loop Motors for Zero Layer Shift
Powered by high-precision closed-loop motors with real-time encoder feedback, the InfiMech MX Series eliminates layer shift caused by accidental bumps or external interference.
- Real-Time Step Tracking: High-resolution encoders continuously monitor motor positions to detect any physical displacement immediately.
- Instant Auto-Recovery: If bumped or pushed out of place, the system compensates in milliseconds, automatically driving the tool back to its exact trajectory to save your print.
## 300*300*300mm Large Build Volume
Versatile 220 × 220 × 220 mm & Generous 300 × 300 × 300 mm Build Volumes. From everyday functional prototypes to large single-piece models and high-volume batch runs, choose the perfect scale for your workflow with uncompromised multi-material flexibility.
## 8mm Precision Cast Aluminum
High-rigidity 8mm cast aluminum design resists thermal warping and ensures edge-to-edge temperature uniformity. Guarantees long-term precision flatness and perfect first-layer adhesion.
## 1.5GT Ultra-Fine Timing Belts
Features a 1.5mm pitch for higher positioning resolution and smoother transmission. Effectively suppresses Vertical Fine Artifacts (VFA) for silky-smooth print surface quality.
## Intelligent Carefree Printing
No manual adjustments, no failed first layers.Built on a high-precision 8mm cast aluminum bed, our automatic leveling dynamically compensates for micro surface variations, ensuring flawless first-layer adhesion across the entire 300 × 300 × 300 mm build space.
Take full command of your print workflow with the 5-inch capacitive touchscreen. Designed for optimal ergonomics, the high-responsiveness display features a smooth tilt adjustment from 50° to 110°, ensuring comfortable viewing and effortless navigation whether your printer is on a low workbench or an eye-level rack.
Integrated accelerometer-based Input Shaping neutralizes XY axis vibrations during high-speed printing. Eliminates ghosting and ringing for flawless, mirror-smooth wall finishes.

## Important Notes Before Purchasing Add-Ons
- Toolhead Compatibility
InfiMech MX Toolhead and MX Pro Toolhead are NOT interchangeable. Please ensure you select the correct version matching your printer model.
- Module & Accessory Compatibility
Feeder Module for MX Pro and Laser Module for MX Pro are only compatible with MX Pro.
Side-blower Fan for MX and Camera for MX are intended as add-ons for MX only (these are included as standard accessories on MX Pro and do not need to be purchased separately).
- Feed Module: Only 1 kit per MX Pro is required to support all 8 dry boxes and feeding channels.
- Filament Color Specifications
All add-on filament bundle colors are fixed pre-set combinations and cannot be modified or custom selected:
PLA-HF X6: Black, White, Red, Grey, Yellow, Orange
PLA-HF X8: Black, White, Red, Grey, Yellow, Pine Green, Blue, Orange
TPU-95A X2 + PLA-HF X2: TPU (Orange, White) + PLA-HF (White, Pine Green)
PA6-CF X2: Black
PETG-HF X6: Black, White, Grey, Orange, Red, Gold
PETG-HF X8: Black, White, Grey, Orange, Red, Gold, Green, Silver

## From Pilot Production to Mass Production
## Our Story
Where It All Began: Engineered for Makers, Driven by Efficiency
For years, multi-color and multi-material 3D printing promised limitless creative freedom. Yet for many makers and engineers, reality told a different story: towering purge towers that waste entire spools of costly filament, excruciating wait times for repetitive retractions, and frequent clogs when mixing rigid plastics with flexible TPU.
We asked ourselves: Why should creativity come at the cost of wasted time, wasted material, and unreliable prints?
InfiMech was founded by a team of veteran 3D printing engineers, industrial designers, and passionate makers with over a decade of hands-on additive manufacturing experience. We set out with a clear purpose: to engineer an accessible, reliable multi-tool system that fundamentally eliminates material waste without compromising speed.
The MX series replaces endless purge delays with dedicated, independent tools and ultra-fast 8-second induction heating. With true zero-waste transitions, print times slashed by up to 80%, and native support for multi-material hybrid printing, we are putting industrial-grade efficiency within reach of every workshop.
The MX series represents our relentless pursuit of efficiency and maker-first engineering. We invite you to join our journey, back the campaign, and help us usher in the new era of waste-free, multi-material 3D printing.
## Acknowledgements
Bringing the InfiMech MX Series to life has been a collaborative journey, and we are deeply grateful to everyone who helped us reach this milestone.
Kickstarter & Our Global Backers: Thank you to the platform and our amazing backers for believing in our vision and giving us the opportunity to innovate.
…(以下省略)
risks: Every crowdfunding journey comes with uncertainties, but this is far from uncharted territory for us. We have been deeply rooted in the 3D printing industry for 9 years, and have built end-to-end capabilities covering core technology R&D, large-scale production control, global after-sales service system establishment, and high-quality supply chain integration. For the APS product alone, we have invested 18 months and substantial human and financial resources in dedicated R&D, iterating 5 prototypes and meticulously refining every detail. It is this accumulation that enables us to face potential challenges with candor and, more importantly, have full confidence in our solutions. We’ll keep you informed with regular updates as we move through the final stages of production. And if anything unexpected comes up, we’ll address it openly, act swiftly, and do everything we can to deliver on our promise—because your satisfaction is our highest priority. This journey isn’t just about bringing APS to life; it’s about honoring the trust you’ve placed in us, just as we have with hundreds of thousands of backers before.

faq.a: Please note that the promotional prices shown on our campaign graphics and reward images are listed in US Dollars (USD) for reference, while Hong Kong Dollars (HKD) is the official billing currency at Kickstarter checkout. The final charge amount will be converted automatically according to your payment card's real-time exchange rate, and your card will only be charged after the campaign successfully ends.

faq.q: Can I modify my pledge or add add-ons after backing, or even after the campaign ends?
faq.a: Yes! While the campaign is live, simply go to your Kickstarter pledge page and click "Manage your pledge" -> "Change your pledge" to switch reward tiers or add more add-ons. After the campaign ends, you will also be able to select additional add-ons during our post-campaign pledge manager survey.

faq.q: How does my $5 VIP deposit work on Kickstarter, and when will it be refunded?
faq.a: The $50 cashback will NOT be deducted automatically during checkout on Kickstarter—you will pledge at the standard Kickstarter tier price first. After the campaign ends, our team will match your Kickstarter backing email with your $5 VIP reservation record. Once your reward ships, we will process the $50 USD cashback directly back to your original payment method.

faq.q: What if I purchased 3 VIP passes, but only backed 2 printers on Kickstarter?
faq.a: Not at all! It will not affect your order. Once your 2 printers ship, you will receive the corresponding VIP cashback for the 2 units you backed ($50 USD per unit).

faq.q: Is the InfiMech MX Series available for worldwide shipping?
faq.a: Yes, we offer shipping to most countries and regions around the world. Please refer to the shipping rate table on our campaign page for reference. If your country or region is not listed, feel free to email our team directly at jojo@infimech.com for a custom shipping quote.

faq.q: When will shipping be charged, and what about applicable taxes and duties?
faq.a: Shipping fees will be collected after the campaign ends via our post-campaign email survey once we confirm your delivery address. Orders to the United States, Canada, Australia, the United Kingdom, and most EU countries are expected to ship from local warehouses. Orders to other destinations will ship from our warehouse in China, and backers may be responsible for any applicable local customs duties, VAT, import taxes, or clearance fees.

faq.q: What is the expected shipping time?
faq.a: Mass production is scheduled to begin right after the campaign concludes, with estimated shipping starting in Q1 2027 (VIP Reservation backers will enjoy priority batch shipping）

faq.q: What coverage is included in the warranty and post-purchase support?
faq.a: Standard orders include a 1-year limited warranty (2 years within the EU, CH, NO, and IS), lifetime technical support, and direct access to genuine replacement parts through our official store. As an exclusive perk, verified VIP Reservation backers receive an extra 1 year of warranty service, bringing their total warranty period to 2 years worldwide, plus lifetime technical support.

faq.q: Is the Automated Filament Feeder required for the MX Pro, and can I use third-party dry boxes for moisture-sensitive filaments?
faq.a: No, the Automated Filament Feeder is completely optional and not required for normal or 8-color printing—the printer works out of the box using the standard side spool holders. The add-on feeder is mainly recommended if you frequently print ultra-soft flexible filaments (such as TPU below 85A), and its 8 sealed chambers also help keep moisture-sensitive filaments dry. You can also freely use any standard, non-motorized third-party dry boxes with PTFE tubes by feeding the filament manually into t…

faq.q: Are the nozzles/toolheads on the MX and MX Pro the same, and are they interchangeable?
faq.a: No, they are different and not interchangeable due to differences in the PTFE tube connector interface. Please make sure to select the add-on toolhead packs specifically labeled for your model (MX vs. MX Pro).

faq.q: Can I remotely monitor or control prints when I am away from home using the built-in camera?
faq.a: Currently, live camera monitoring and remote control are supported over your local area network (LAN) when connected to the same home Wi-Fi network.

faq.q: Where does the auxiliary side-blower cooling fan mount on the MX, and does the printer support automatic Pressure Advance calibration?
faq.a: The base MX features three dedicated mounting holes on the side panel for installing the auxiliary cooling fan (note: this fan is already pre-installed on the MX Pro). Please note that the printer does not currently support automatic Pressure Advance calibration.

faq.q: What are the optical power and wavelength of the Laser Engraving Module, and can it operate independently from 3D printing?
faq.a: It is a 10W optical output semiconductor diode laser with a wavelength of 445 ± 5 nm. Yes, the laser module operates completely independently from the 3D printing function.

faq.q: What materials can the Laser Engraving Module engrave and cut, and what is the maximum cutting thickness?
faq.a: It can engrave and cut wood, opaque acrylic, leather, paper/cardboard, anodized/coated metals, leaves, non-mirror stainless steel, stone, mugs, and more. For cutting performance, it can cut through 8 mm plywood at a speed of 120 mm/min.

faq.q: How does the Laser Engraving Module mount to the printer, and what software does it use?
faq.a: The module attaches directly onto the carriage via our quick-swap toolchanger system (no complex wiring required). You can control it either directly through InfiMech Orca or with dedicated third-party laser software (such as LightBurn/LaserGRBL).
